summary_md: **圓山宗智 ([@Processing_Unit](https://x.com/Processing_Unit/status/2115808441516322945))** used Claude Code to design **mmRISC-2**, a 64-bit RV64GC RISC-V core with L1/L2 caches, MMU, BTB, FPU and JTAG/cJTAG debugger that boots Linux on an Arty A7 FPGA after one month ([munetomo-maruyama/mmRISC-2](https://github.com/munetomo-maruyama/mmRISC-2)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - munetomo-maruyama/mmRISC-2: 64-bit RISC-V (RV64GC) core that boots Linux on an Arty A7 FPGA. Designed entirely by Claude Code: the specifications, RTL, verification and documents were all written by the AI.

relevance: Striking example of agentic coding on hardware design.
